title: A special order received at another location is not offered with its vendor
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin who can pick two locations in the location selector, {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919) and {Location-B} (for example Staging Lethbridge - 4310). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Vendor {Vendor-A} (for example the first vendor in Parts → Vendors) exists.
  • Within the last 12 months, {Location-B} received part number {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SOOTHER-01) from {Vendor-A} on a special-order line of work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15440).
  • {Location-A} never received {Part-A} and does not stock it.
  • Work order {Work-order-2} (for example S2-15441) at {Location-A} is open, for a ZZAUTOTEST customer, with a line {Line-1} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST PL other location line").
custom_steps:
1. Pick {Location-A} in the location selector in the top bar.
  2. In the top bar click Work Orders.
  3. Open {Work-order-2}.
  4. In the Parts row of {Line-1} click + Add Part.
  5. In New Part Request, type {Part-A} in Part Number.
  6. Read every result offered for {Part-A} and the line under each.
  7. Close the dialog without saving.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 6: No result for {Part-A} shows the source "Part Library · {Vendor-A}", because {Location-A} did not receive it. If {Part-A} is offered from the shared list, its source reads "Part Library".
  • Step 7: The dialog closes and nothing is added to {Line-1}.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10825 (Story 12, Call the Shared Parts List the Part Library); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S12-R14a, S12-R14, S12-R10, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 6.1 (While active: GREASETUBE is found), 13 Oct copy. Product's answer of 13 Oct (Chris Ward, question 2). Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S12-R14a: “A special-order lookup result is a part number this location received from a vendor on a special-order line (a received line with no inventory part, and not a core) in the last 12 months.”
  • S12-R14: “A special-order lookup result shows its source as "Part Library · {vendor}".”
  • S12-R10: “A part lookup result that comes from the shared list shows its source as "Part Library".”
